name: BNB Chain

binding_cap.short_note: Capped by Security Posture -- first chain bound by this gate, via the new remediation clock (Principle 16) applied to the 2022 Token Hub exploit.

key_findings: First chain bound by the Security Posture gate, and first exercise of the new remediation clock -- the 2022 Token Hub exploit aged from a would-be FAIL to Partial-eligible via 3.5 clean years plus the Fusion structural remediation.
On-Chain Health (86) is elite-broad -- highest DAU of any chain scored (~4M+ daily), 31M peak daily transactions, though measured partly under an active gas-subsidy campaign.
At 5 clean years (October 2027) the exploit history fully ages out of the gate; a tier-1 audit of the modern client would put Pass in reach.
Best full-EVM execution profile scored at the time -- 0.45s blocks, ~0.65s average deterministic finality, 5,200 TPS benchmark throughput.
KYA (63) carries the strongest agent-identity registration depth on the board -- ERC-8004 registries live since Feb 2026 with ~89k registered agents, plus the native BAP-578 standard.
Deterministic Finality Partial cap (75) does not bind -- BNB retains a probabilistic fallback path that holds the gate at Partial despite best-in-class normal-mode speed.

watch_items: Watch for a tier-1 audit commission of the modern, heavily-diverged bsc client -- would close the sole gap holding the Security Posture gate at Partial.
0-Fee Stablecoin Carnival subsidy is still running -- re-assess On-Chain Health once it lapses.
BNB's announced agent-purpose L1 (late-2026 testnet target) would be a new chain to score, not a BNB re-credit, when it ships.
